name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1897: Tonight isolation work compared paths with a raw startswith, four times, and that is a coin flip on two of his three surfaces: on Windows the same directory arrives in two cases and the rule decides a fixture is his real tree, and on his Mac the mirror, where the filesystem is case-insensitive so an uppercased spelling is the same directory while the comparison calls it different and isolated writes land in his real folder. The filesystem decides now, by inode, walking up the ancestors, with case normalisation only as the fallback for a directory that does not exist yet. One definition, four sites, five cases guarded.
